issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath grammar DATETIME ('Z'? after partial date) and TIME/TIMEFORMAT ('Z' allowed) vs FHIR dateTime/time datatype semantics; AGENTS.md FP-06/CQL-11 documented decisions
issues.evidence: @2018Z and @T12:30Z are rejected (is_valid=false, empty) identically in native extension and Python fallback. Grammar permits 'Z' lexically, but FHIR datetime semantics disallow a timezone without time components and the FHIR time datatype has no timezone; rejection is documented strictness (FP-06 invariant, CQL-11 note). Full dual-engine parity.
issues.resolution: INTENDED: documented strict temporal-literal policy; both engines lockstep; no fixture mandates acceptance

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §7 aggregate; §7 spec dedup example; grammar LONGNUMBER
issues.evidence: HISTORIAN extension coverage all conformant dual-engine: $index inside aggregator is 0-based current-item index (a.aggregate($this+$total+$index,0)=63); init evaluated once and may reference outer context (a.aggregate($this+$total,a.count())=63); chained/nested aggregates work; spec §7 dedup example iif($total contains $this,...) returns [3,2,1] in both engines; collection accumulation union order consistent. Lexical: .5/1./1e3/3.5L rejected; 007/1L/0.0 accepted per grammar; quantity literals 10 'mg'/10 'cm/mmol' parse with .value/.unit; comments not stripped inside string literals; DIV/MOD/IN uppercase rejected; non-ASCII identifiers rejected; empty backtick identifier accepted (grammar allows); whitespace around '.' navigation tolerated. No divergence between native and Python paths on any probe.
issues.resolution: Verification-only pin; no code change required
